== Summary ==
Four empty [[Unofficial repackaged products|Vintage Sports Cards "Collectible Card Game" repack boxes]]. Two show the printed "Over $45 Value For Only $14.99" badge; one has a yellow "Fantastic Value For Only $9.99" sticker over the badge corner. The bottom-left box shows the Vintage Sports Cards, Inc. repackaging notice.

Photo provided by [[Jeremy Christoffel]].
